finding: Exact retention plus lookup C/K remains faster than full analytical constitutive evaluation for all four tested materials, with about 20-24% lower constitutive evaluation cost on this optimized-Fortran screen.
tradeoff: The split representation is slower than a full lookup, but F-AHL04C showed that it nearly eliminates the nonlinear Richards response discrepancy that remained with full lookup.
nonclaims: One-time build cost is not included in this inner-loop benchmark.
